title: ChaSet ThemeConfig
description: The single theme-configuration object persisted and exchanged by the ChaSet theme control. This is the ONLY structured payload a host must store to reproduce a theme. Boundary: this schema covers exactly the axes marked `covered` in spec/theme-controls.json. Window material, window tint, and background image are hostOnly and MUST NOT be added here — scripts/check-theme-boundary.mjs fails the gate if they are.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped only on breaking shape changes; hosts must reject unknown versions rather than guess.

mode.description: Requested appearance. `system` resolves through the host's OS detection. Corresponds to crd 主题偏好 {auto,light,dark} with `auto` renamed to `system`; dt's `system` already matches.

palette.description: Accent palette selection. The id list is the 10-item canonical launcher palette (spec/theme-controls.json axes.palette).

id.description: Canonical launcher palette id. `neutral` = no override (fall back to base accent). `custom` = derive the whole accent ramp from `customHex`.

customHex.description: Required in practice when id is `custom`, ignored otherwise. A single 6-digit sRGB hex; the ramp is derived per spec/theme-controls.json axes.palette.subcases.custom.derivation. Hosts SHOULD also accept this key when id !== custom so a user's picked colour survives a round-trip through `neutral`.

decoration.description: Radius / shadow / motion expression. Canonically the launcher model: a style preset plus a continuous level plus per-key overrides. All numeric leaves are re-derived by each host through the SAME interpolation contract (spec/theme-controls.json derivedContract) — the config carries the intent, never the resolved px/ms.

styleId.description: Decoration preset. `simple` matches crd's data-interface-style="simple" and dt's flat look; `expressive` is the richer counterpart.

level.description: Master decoration amount. Radius, shadow and motion all scale from this unless individually overridden. crd field 装饰程度.

overrides.description: Per-key escape hatch. A key present here means 'use this explicit value instead of following `level`'. Only keys ChaSet actually owns a token for are permitted — backgroundImageOpacity is deliberately absent because the background image is hostOnly.

radius.description: Drives primitives.radius / composite corner radii. crd 装饰参数.radius.

shadow.description: Drives composite shadow tokens. crd 装饰参数.shadow.

motion.description: Drives primitives.motion durations. crd 装饰参数.motion.

typography.description: Type selection. ChaSet owns a single typography scale (primitives.typography -> tokens.css + Typography.generated.qml); both hosts consume the SAME generated scale, so this object only picks a family and a size preset.

familyId.description: Logical family slot, NOT a font-family list. Each host maps it to exactly ONE concrete family name: Qt does not parse comma-separated family lists and silently falls back to the default font.

scaleId.description: Size preset applied multiplicatively across the shared typography scale.

uiScale.description: Global density multiplier. Both hosts already expose this as ThemeTokens.uiScale; the control only surfaces it in the UI.
